user.title: Account operations
user.description: Staff actions for this account. Consequential changes require a second confirmation.
user.reasonOptional: Optional; recorded in the staff audit log.
user.vacationDuration: Vacation mode lasts 14 days. The reason is recorded as an administrator-initiated vacation.
user.passwordResult: A password reset email was requested. No password is shown here.
user.accountResetResult: Account reset completed. New account ID: {{newUserId}}.
user.invalidTarget: The account ID is invalid. Close this panel and reload the user record.
user.requestFailed: The request failed. Check your access and try again.

password.title: Send password reset email?
password.message: The account owner will receive a password reset email. No password will be generated or displayed to staff.

reset.title: Reset this account?
reset.message: This is a destructive administrator action. Account progress may be removed. Add an audit reason if useful, then confirm only if this reset is intended.

vacation-start.title: Start 14-day vacation mode?
vacation-start.message: The account will be unable to log in during vacation mode. The current API records a fixed 14-day duration.

vacation-end.title: End vacation mode?
vacation-end.message: Vacation mode will end immediately for this account.

suspend.title: Suspend this account?
suspend.message: The player cannot sign in or play until the suspension ends. Their email is blocked from registering again for the same period.

ban.title: Ban this account?
ban.message: The player cannot sign in or play, and their email cannot register a new account. Supporter renewals stop. They may file a ban appeal.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this account?
reactivate.message: Ends the current suspension, ban or closure immediately and lifts the re-registration block.

close.title: Close this account?
close.message: The account is closed, its password and staff access are revoked, and supporter renewals stop. Game data is kept; an administrator can reactivate it.

erase.title: Delete this account?
erase.message: The account is closed now and its personal data is permanently erased after a 14-day grace period. You can cancel or expedite the deletion from the Privacy tab.

user.statusDescription: Current status: {{status}}. Suspensions and bans block sign-in and are recorded in the status history.
user.durationInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
user.reasonRequired: Required; recorded in the status history and staff audit log.
user.reasonMin: Required, at least {{count}} characters; recorded in the staff audit log.
user.eraseResult: Account closed and scheduled for deletion. Track or expedite it in the Privacy tab.

erasureErrors.reason_required: A reason of at least 10 characters is required.
erasureErrors.staff_account: Staff accounts must be closed, not deleted. Remove their staff roles first.
erasureErrors.already_scheduled: This account already has a deletion scheduled. See the Privacy tab.
erasureErrors.not_found: Player not found or already deleted.

export.failed: The export could not be downloaded. Check your access and try again.
export.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid export. No file was downloaded.

bots.title: Bot operations
bots.description: Inspect the registered bot roster, preview provisioning, and run a scheduled bot tick.
bots.accessDeniedDescription: Bot status and operations are available to administrators only.
bots.loadFailed: Bot status could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
bots.empty: No bots are registered. Select a manifest below to preview or provision bots.
bots.manifestDescription: Choices come from registered manifest files on this server.
bots.scheduleDescription: Choices come from registered schedule files on this server.
bots.confirmProvisionMessage: Create the bots listed in the {{manifest}} manifest? This changes account data.
bots.confirmRunMessage: Run the {{schedule}} schedule against the registered bot accounts now?
bots.actionFailed: The operation failed. Check your access and try again.
